acceptance.goal_relevant_low_salience_recall: strictly greater than paired no-goal recall

claim_boundary: Computational sensory-gate behavior only; not biological sensory reproduction, semantic understanding, energy evidence, or a changed scientific claim grade.
omission_contract: An explicit adapter observation of a previously expected missing channel; never inferred from an absent key in a partial sample and never evaluator truth.

statistical_analysis.interval_method: paired nonparametric bootstrap over episode/world blocks

stop_conditions: fewer than five unique primary seeds
goal, sample, state, or Spark contains evaluator truth, target, label, test-only, contradiction, or answer fields
an invalid multi-channel sample changes any state or counter
inspection mutates thresholds, counters, sequence, or feature state
serialized replay changes Spark IDs, trace rows, counters, or state hashes
a score term or ablation is missing from accepted/suppressed trace
dense channel evaluation is reported as active downstream work

work_counters.candidate_channels: channels at or above threshold before top-k
work_counters.channels_inspected: every input or explicit-omission channel read
work_counters.features_scored: every channel with all enabled score terms computed
work_counters.sparks_emitted: PerceptualSparks emitted after threshold and top-k
